project.name: AI Lesson Recorder · 暖色教育风重设计

intentProfile.routingReason: New design project, no active Design Library, no restore target, 3 stateful desktop pages → free-fast stateful lane.

styleContinuityAnchors.direction: Warm, friendly education (教育温暖亲和风). Less cold-tool, more human classroom.
principles: Warm ivory background everywhere — never pure #F8FAFC cold gray. Cards are pure white with warm beige 1px borders.
Reduce colored pill noise: max ONE semantic color per card (risk level). Replace green/blue/amber/red quad-colored ribbons with warm primary + ONE accent.
Generous breathing room: card padding 24-28px, section gaps 28-36px, content max-width 1280px centered with 40px gutters.
Friendly rounded corners: cards 20px (lg), buttons 14px (md), chips 10px (sm). Avatars fully round.
Soft warm-tinted shadows: use --lr-shadow-sm / --lr-shadow-md. Never harsh black drop-shadows.
Larger, friendlier type: page titles 28-32px / 700; section heads 18-20px / 700; body 14-15px. Use display font for titles.
Add warmth via small human touches: student avatar with initials in soft colored circle, topic color stripe on cards, friendly empty-state illustration spots, waveform-style audio chips.
Replace the dark navy top bar with a clean white/cream top bar + 1px warm border + soft shadow. Friendlier and lighter.
Step bar: 4 steps as connected progress dots (numbered circles + labels + connector line). Active step filled primary, completed steps soft-green with check, future steps muted.
Status badges: soft tinted background + colored dot + dark text (e.g. amber-soft + amber dot + '待审核'), never hard solid color fills.
Evidence timestamp chips: small pill with play-triangle icon + '00:35' mono + waveform bars hint — reads as an audio clip, not a plain button.

typography.display: Plus Jakarta Sans (titles, English) + Noto Sans SC (Chinese)
typography.body: Plus Jakarta Sans + Noto Sans SC

styleContinuityAnchors.iconography: lucide-react icons via <i data-lucide> with 1.5-2px stroke, rendered inside soft circular tinted backgrounds (primary-soft / accent-soft). Friendly, not technical.

components.topBar: white/cream bg, 1px bottom warm border, soft shadow, h-16, brand mark left (warm green leaf/book icon + 'AI Lesson Recorder'), contextual center (student name when in workspace), actions right (save draft / generate report outline buttons, EN toggle circle)
components.courseCard: white card 20px radius, 24px padding, topic color stripe top-left 4px, avatar circle top-right, student name + meta, status dot+label, action button bottom. Hover: lift + shadow-md.
components.stepBar: horizontal row of 4 numbered circles connected by a 2px line. Circle 28px. Active: filled primary + white number + bold label. Completed: primary-soft + check icon. Future: muted bg + muted number.
components.summaryHeroCard: large white card, accent-soft tinted left edge or top banner, friendly illustration spot, big title, summary text, progress ring + actions.
components.reviewCard: white card, risk-level left border (4px amber/coral/info), title row with confirm checkbox (custom rounded), message, evidence clip chips row, teacher note textarea (warm muted bg), ignore button ghost.
components.evidenceChip: pill: play-triangle in primary circle + mono timestamp + 3-bar waveform icon. Reads as an audio clip.
